limits: This audit re-reads original XML, numeric sanitized observations and retained process/capture receipts; no app, engine, build or tests are executed.

Reveal, selection, clearing and projection revisions establish local renderer state. Play acceptance is action-specific inference from the immediate Standard UI, not an internal authority receipt or revision.
Pre-input snapshots and matching observed ownership do not guarantee atomic delivery before publication expiry or continuously verify every physical frame/transform.
Original screenshots are retained but no pixel-privacy or TalkBack speech/focus/traversal claim is made here.
Production normal-text API36 practice only; adaptive resizing/font scenarios, physical devices, store signing, physical LAN and iOS remain separate.
